costGuide.title: Nissan VR38DETT Engine Replacement Cost (UK)
costGuide.labourLine: Fitting a VR38DETT typically takes 12-18 hours at independent GT-R specialist rates (£85-£150/hr) - significantly higher than mainstream engines due to the twin-turbo V6's complexity and the GT-R's transaxle layout .
paragraphs: What genuinely moves the price for the VR38DETT is the power level you're aiming for. Standard reconditioned units for road use sit in the lower band, but if the engine is being rebuilt for high-power applications (800hp+), forged internals, upgraded turbos, and aftermarket oiling solutions can push costs well beyond £20,000. See our full reconditioned engine cost guide.

failures.title: Nissan VR38DETT Engine Problems - What Actually Fails

items.title: High-RPM Oil Aeration - All R35 GT-Rs, Particularly Track-Used Cars
items.onset: From 7,000+rpm sustained operation; particularly high-mileage cars 50,000+ miles
items.whatHappens: At high engine speeds, crankcase windage becomes severe enough to aerate the oil. Air bubbles reach the oil pump pickup, pressure drops, and bearings starve. This can cause bottom-end bearing damage over time, especially on track-driven cars. Aftermarket deep sump oil pans (e.g., AMS Alpha, GT1R) are a common preventative fix, adding 1.5 quarts of capacity and relocating the pickup to avoid aeration.
items.repairVsReplace: If caught early with pressure data, an upgraded oil pan solves the issue. If ignored to the point of bearing failure, full bottom-end rebuild is required - crank, bearings, and potentially girdle work. The forum-sourced example of an engine with bottom-end damage requiring full rebuild confirms this can be a terminal failure mode. Read our full engine oiling system failure guide

items.title: High-Mileage Wear - Turbocharger and Valve Train
items.whatHappens: The IHI twin turbos are robust at stock power levels, but with age and mileage, wastegate rattle and bearing wear can develop. The valve train - particularly valve springs - can fatigue on high-mileage or frequently-tracked cars, with the OEM springs showing degradation at sustained high RPM.
items.repairVsReplace: Turbo rebuilds (£800-£2,000 each) or replacement with upgraded units is common. Valve spring replacement with uprated items (JUN offers a VR38-specific set at ¥189,000 MSRP ) is a sensible preventative step on high-mileage engines being rebuilt. Read our full turbo failure guide

failures.goodYearsLine: The VR38DETT received continuous updates throughout its run. 2017+ engines benefit from revised turbos and better cooling from the factory . Nismo-spec engines use higher-spec components, including additional strengthening, making them the most durable factory variant .

variants.title: How to Confirm You Have the VR38DETT
variants.intro: The VR38DETT was purpose-built for the R35 GT-R and never used in any other Nissan production model. Confirming your car has one is straightforward - if you own an R35-generation GT-R, you have a VR38DETT. The engine code is stamped on the engine block (front-left side of the block, visible from underneath with undertrays removed) and appears on the V5C registration document for all UK-market GT-Rs. Which similar-looking codes it is commonly confused with: - VQ38DETT - does not exist as a factory Nissan code - VQ35DE/HR - the 3.5L V6 from the 350Z, completely unrelated - VR35 - a development code, never reached production Fitting the wrong revision matters: Early VR38DETTs (2007-2010) differ from later units in turbocharger design, ECU calibration, and internal component specification - 2017+ engines use upgraded turbos and a different oil pump design, among other changes .

buyingGuide.title: Buying a Replacement VR38DETT - What to Choose

options.label: Used
options.body: A used VR38DETT only makes sense with verified documentation - full service history, known mileage, compression test results, and ideally bore-scope images of cylinder walls. The example of a £3,000 complete engine on GT-R forum requiring a rebuild demonstrates that cheap used units are usually damaged goods . For standard road cars, a good used unit from a specialist with warranty is viable.

options.label: Reconditioned
options.body: A proper VR38DETT recon addresses the known weak points. The oil pan should be upgraded to a deep sump design (AMS/GT1R) to prevent oil aeration , valve springs should be inspected or replaced with uprated items, turbos should be assessed for wear, and all gaskets and seals renewed. A thorough recon also address the bottom-end bearings. For most owners, this is the sensible middle ground.

options.label: Rebuilt
options.body: A full VR38DETT rebuild is justified when chasing serious power (800hp+) or when the engine has suffered catastrophic failure. A proper rebuild should include forged pistons and rods, billet crankshaft, upgraded main bearings, and an aftermarket oil pan . Specialist packages from JDMGarageUK start from £7,000 and climb to nearly £50,000 for full high-spec builds .

buyingGuide.supplyFitLine: Fitting a VR38DETT through our network puts you in touch with UK GT-R specialists who know the platform inside out. Nationwide delivery and supply-fit options available, with warranty on every completed installation.
buyingGuide.vehicleValueNote: The R35 GT-R is a performance icon that retains significant value. R35 values range from £35,000 for earlier high-mileage examples to over £150,000 for late Nismo models . A £12,000-£18,000 engine replacement represents 10-50% of vehicle value. For high-mileage early cars approaching the lower value range, weigh the cost of a full recon against the car's overall value and condition. For later or Nismo cars, replacement is almost always financially justified.
